title: LPM start: connection, IDs and routing
description: Use first for an LPM (lpm.rocks) request when no other lpm-* skill clearly fits, an ID is unknown, a tool is missing or denied (-32003, ferramenta ausente), to connect an agent (conectar, configurar MCP) or read your notificações. Routes to one skill. Not for changing API keys (use lpm-access).
doneWhen: The connection can run the needed tools (or the user knows exactly how to enable them), the IDs are resolved, and exactly one skill was chosen.
authorityCeiling: Reads only; `mark_notification_read` is the only write.
jobs: a ferramenta de criar atividade não aparece no ChatGPT

references.loadWhen: playbook connection: a tool is missing, denied or returns -32003; "what can this connector do?"; "I reinstalled the connector"
playbook agent-setup: connect or configure LPM in an agent, fix a `*.run.app` URL, or verify a new setup
playbook resolve-ids: a workspaceId or projectId is unknown, or "what is the id of project <name>?"
playbook notifications: read my LPM notifications, or mark one as read
playbook who-can-manage: you cannot manage a project or workspace (access.canManage false), or "who can give me access?"
playbook route: any other LPM request, or a request that spans several skills
the routing table that playbook route matches the request against
